honest_scope: Current surfaced story-lane path only: run `mvp_ingest` (Break Down Script) followed by `world_building` (Deep Breakdown) on a fresh screenplay project. Excludes unfinished film-lane generation, export, and any pretend full-pipeline runtime claim.

recipes.notes: Tier 1 story-lane ingest: canonical script, scene breakdown, script bible, project config.
Tier 2 story-lane enrichment: scene analysis, entity bibles, continuity, and graph.

cases.notes: Medium-length screenplay to anchor realistic story-lane throughput between trivial and full-length extremes.
